verdict.rationale: Mercury versions its API under /api/v1/ and its docs hub offers a version picker (v1-pre, v1, v2). It also publishes a dated public changelog with migration guidance for behavior changes, such as the credit statement endpoint change effective after June 15, 2026. However, the evidence states that no written deprecation or sunset policy is published anywhere on docs.mercury.com, so the deprecation-policy half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods and support timelines, a documented relationship between the v1 and v2 API versions, and independent corroboration of versioning stability.
